title: Avoid zero-sized batches at exact capacity boundaries
description: The same pantry.py planner partitions separate preparation orders. An arithmetic refactor creates an extra empty batch when an amount exactly fills its containers. Repair split_batches(amounts, limit). amounts is a list of at most 100 whole-number JSON values from 0 through 1000; limit is a whole-number JSON value from 1 through 100. Each amount is a separate order and must not be pooled with adjacent orders. Whole-number JSON values mean finite integral numbers after JSON transport, excluding booleans; no Python int-versus-float distinction is promised. None/null, nonintegral numbers, other shapes, and inputs outside the stated bounds are outside this retained contract.

requirements.text: For each positive amount, return an inner list of limit-sized batches followed by one remainder batch only when the remainder is positive. The inner list sums to that amount; no batch is zero. Preserve the outer order, and partition each amount independently.
A zero amount produces an empty inner list in its original position. An empty amounts list produces an empty outer list.
Do not change the content or order of the input amounts list while computing the batches.
